designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Secretary of the Interior to acquire the remains of Fort Union and to establish Fort Union Trading Post National Historic Site in North Dakota and Montana.
designationHistory.note: Sec. 2 of the act called for formal establishment by Federal Register notice once the land was acquired; that notice was not located.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (North Dakota), 'Authorized June 20, 1966'
